title: chamaesyce garberi
intro: Chamaesyce garberi, commonly known as Sandmat, is a succulent plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Caribbean region, due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sandmat are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. These constituents are responsible for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
